Rabbit Reverie Inspo

13 Sep 2025 - strawberryjam

I try to take pictures of things that inspire me. Or keep their tab open. Or save them on IG, etc. But it was really unorganized! Sometimes they'd exist in a tab on phone or my computer or a picture on my phone, etc.

I made a mini gallery website and enabled tagging feature.. I really like that so now if I want to do something like design a headdress, all my inspiration is located in one place now!


I had this thought rolling around in my mind for some time... but never had time to execute it so I'm quite proud I finally did it!

If you're interested in checking it out, I can share a login in with you. Let me know!
